about: Measured in the original Portal by tools/parity.mjs orig checks/oracle/fling.json. Values are what the original did; tol is how far the port may be off. Notes say when a value is derived rather than read directly.

settings.sampler: getpos once per tick. It reports the client view of the eye position (cl_smooth 0 during runs), blended between ticks, so times are good to about a tick; rates, speeds and heights are medians or fits. One sample per tick checked by a free fall (0.135 units per tick squared = 600 u/s²).

fling100_apex_feet_gain.note: feet height reached after coming back up, minus the drop height. Original loses 2-8 units; port conserves energy exactly (floor-to-floor fix in teleportPlayer). Tol 10 is a judgement call, not measured noise.

fling100_eye_pop_t.note: original eye rises ~47 units ~0.35 s after the exit; port does not model it yet, cause unknown (eye-only data)

fling100_eye_pop.note: original eye rises ~47 units ~0.35 s after the exit; port does not model it yet, cause unknown (eye-only data)

fling100_entry_vz.note: depends on how long the player fell during setup; the original starts falling during the setup sleep so its entry differs from the port by ~30

fling100_exit_vz.note: depends on how long the player fell during setup; the original starts falling during the setup sleep so its entry differs from the port by ~30
